name: openIMSs
what_it_is: An open-source, containerized IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem) platform for practical 4G/5G telecommunications development, integrating Open5GS, OpenSIPS IMS, srsRAN, and UERANSIM into 40+ microservices. It supports voice, video, data, RCS, and IM services across NSA and SA deployment modes.
components: UDM, UDR, AUSF, NSSF, PCF, BSF, NRF, SCP (5GC network functions)
P-CSCF, I-CSCF, S-CSCF (OpenSIPS-based Call Session Control Functions)
FHOSS (Open IMS Core Home Subscriber Server)
protocols: RTP / SRTP (media transport via RTP Engine)
measurement: HEPify Server (SIP capture and call-flow analysis)
configuration: Port 36412/SCTP (MME) and 38412/SCTP (AMF) exposed for remote eNB/gNB
Port 2152/UDP exposed for GTP-U data plane in distributed mode
ZMQ transport configurable in srsRAN for simulation without SDR hardware
modes: Co-located: eNB/gNB and core on same Docker network
Distributed: eNB/gNB on separate host/network with explicit port exposure
Simulation: ZMQ-based radio emulation without physical SDR hardware
constraints: IPv6 is not supported in the Docker environment
Tested exclusively on Ubuntu 22.04; other platforms are untested
Physical radio mode requires Ettus USRP B210 SDR hardware
WebUI credentials are hardcoded (admin/1423) with no documented credential rotation
No built-in fault injection or chaos engineering framework
notable_absences: No fault injection or chaos engineering capability
No multi-site or inter-PLMN federation capability
No security/encryption configuration details (IPsec, TLS cert management)
docker-compose.yml not found at the expected raw GitHub path (may use non-standard branch or layout)
No CI/CD pipeline or automated test suite documented
